subject: barney
label: barney, in the place of the game's models/barney.mdl

measured.lineup: ours is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/hassassin.mdl, models/scientist.mdl, models/zombie.mdl: the judge does not know which

M1.reason: The outline reads as the brief's stocky man: wide shoulders, a boxy dark vest over a blue shirt, a cap-topped head, grey trousers and boots. The front, back and side views agree, and no limb or armour piece sticks out wrongly. The only gap is the missing tie, which is charged to M3.

M2.reason: Measured 26 x 30 x 76.7 units against a brief height of 75 (offset 0.023), inside the 15% band.

M3.reason: Parts checked against the brief: blue shirt (present, visible at the collar and belly), dark tie (not found: the only dark vertical bar is on the vest's front in the front view, and the shirt below the vest shows no tie), grey trousers (present), helmet (present, but it reads as a short black cap with a flat top rather than a helmet), bulletproof vest (present, front and back), pistol holster on the belt (a black block at the right hip in the front-left view, and a belt across the waist; the pistol itself is not distinct), two arms, two hands, two legs, two boots. The missing tie caps M3 at 1.

M4.reason: Blue shirt, dark vest, grey trousers, pale skin and black holster and boots are each the colour the brief names. Nothing reads as the wrong material.

M5.reason: The grey trousers carry a fine striped texture, and the vest has blocky straps. The face is a plain pale mass with no eyes, mouth or features, which a guard's face would show. The brief asks for little surface detail, but the blank face and the missing tie/pistol definition leave the surface sparse. Held at 1.

M6.reason: In the line-up (slot D) it reads as a low-poly Half-Life-style guard of the right size and palette, and it could pass in passing. Up close, though, the head is a featureless pale block under a flat black cap, and the blocky construction is clearly cruder than the scientist (slot B) and the other game models beside it. A player would notice the cruder build, so 1.

M7.reason: The front is clear: the vest with its central strap faces forward in the front view, the figure stands upright, and its feet sit on the origin in the side views.

M8.reason: Triangle count 658, below the limit of max(2 x 504 median, 731 three-quarter mark) = 1008. The SMAK check reports no errors (checkErrors empty), so the model is fit for GoldSrc.

C1.reason: Across the eight run frames (0 to 22 of 22) the arms stay at the vest's sides, the legs stay attached at the hips, the belt bar stays at the waist and the feet stay on a common baseline. No part comes apart or floats. The frames are small, so fine limb detail is only roughly checked.
